blocks.instruction: Leia o texto e escolha a alternativa correta. Algumas perguntas pedem inferência — a resposta não está escrita com todas as letras.
blocks.passage:
Congratulations! You are here, and this is not a small thing. Forty lessons. Many new words, emails, and meetings.

Today we use the present perfect to look back. I have learned. We have improved. She has written many emails. Your journey in English has officially started.

Today you have five useful words and a lot of practice. Take your time. Every sentence counts.

items.q: How many lessons has the student finished?
items.why: "Forty lessons." — o texto diz quarenta aulas.

items.q: Which grammar does the lesson use to look back?
items.why: "Today we use the present perfect to look back."

items.q: What does the student have today?
options: Five useful words and a lot of practice
items.why: "Today you have five useful words and a lot of practice."

items.q: The text says "this is not a small thing." This suggests that the author…
options: is not happy with the student
thinks the lessons are too easy
wants the student to stop now
thinks the student's progress is important
items.why: Inferência: o autor valoriza o progresso — não é pouca coisa chegar até aqui.

items.q: "Take your time. Every sentence counts." The author would most likely DISAGREE with…
options: "Finish fast and do not check your answers."
"Go slowly and think about each sentence."
items.why: Inferência: o texto pede calma e atenção, então terminar às pressas sem revisar é o contrário.

blocks.instruction: Ouça Emma falando sobre a jornada do aluno. Responda sem ler a transcrição — ela só aparece depois de corrigir.

audio.text:
Hello, and welcome to this special lesson. My name is Emma, and I want to talk to you today.

You have come a long way. When we started, English was new and difficult. Now look at you. You have learned many words. You have written emails to your team. You have joined meetings and you have understood them. That is real progress.

I am very proud of you. I have watched many students, and I know this is not easy. You have practised every day, and every day counts. Small steps make a big journey.

So today, let us stop for one moment and look back. You have started something good. Please continue. The best part is still in front of you. Thank you, and see you in the next lesson.
audio.label: Ouça quantas vezes precisar. A transcrição aparece depois de corrigir.

items.q: Who is speaking in the audio?
items.why: "My name is Emma."

items.q: What has the student done, according to Emma?
options: Learned words, written emails and joined meetings
items.why: "You have learned many words. You have written emails… You have joined meetings."

items.q: How does Emma feel about the student?
items.why: "I am very proud of you."

items.q: When Emma says "Small steps make a big journey," she suggests that…
options: big changes happen in one day
the student should study only once
daily practice adds up over time
items.why: Inferência: passos pequenos e diários somam e criam um grande progresso.

items.q: "The best part is still in front of you." This suggests that Emma wants the student to…
items.why: Inferência: o melhor ainda está por vir, então ela incentiva o aluno a continuar.

blocks.instruction: O vocabulário da lição aparece aqui em frases novas. Escolha o sentido ou a palavra que cabe no contexto.

items.q: "I want to learn three new words today." To learn means to…
items.why: Learn = aprender: ganhar conhecimento ou habilidade.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "After forty lessons, my English shows real ___."
items.why: Progress = progresso, o avanço no inglês.

items.q: "I am very proud of my work this month." Proud means…
options: happy and pleased with something you did
items.why: Proud = orgulhoso: contente com algo que você fez.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "Do not stop now. Please ___ your studies."
items.why: Continue = continuar: seguir com os estudos.

items.q: "My English journey has started." A journey is…
options: a long trip or path over time
items.why: Journey = jornada: um caminho ou percurso ao longo do tempo.

blocks.instruction: Expressões simples de trabalho. Escolha o sentido no contexto.

items.q: "Great job! Keep it up and you will improve fast." Keep it up means…
items.why: Keep it up = continue assim, mantenha o bom trabalho.

items.q: "You have come a long way with your English." To come a long way means to…
items.why: Come a long way = evoluir muito, progredir bastante.

items.q: "Let's look back at everything you have learned." To look back means to…
items.why: Look back = olhar para trás, refletir sobre o que já passou.

items.q: "You did well. Well done!" Well done means…
items.why: Well done = muito bem, parabéns pelo trabalho.

items.q: "I have started, and now I want to carry on." To carry on means to…
items.why: Carry on = seguir em frente, continuar.
